content:
maddie: quick proposal — we need a single phased exposure policy for client errors + console badging. current gap: routing/quota vs consumer-facing phrasing is inconsistent.
jamal: agree. can we avoid inventing another status bucket? keep the canonical server-side tags but control exposure level separately.
tara: +1. what phases are you thinking? hidden -> soft_badge -> visible?
maddie: exactly. hidden = only telemetry, soft_badge = minimal console indicator + SDK hint, visible = explicit client error field and help link. example payload for soft_badge: ```json
{
  "code": "DEGRADED_ROUTING",
  "http_status": 503,
  "client_hint": "retry:short",
  "exposure_phase": "soft_badge"
}
```
ethan: love the exposure_phase field. will need stability in SDKs — prefer simple enum values. also need a mapping table for console copy per-phase.
remy: telemetry ask: add metric tag `exposure_phase` and `routing_tier` so we can slice impact. will start a waveform to compare token cost vs phase.
natalie: related: console UX — soft_badge should be a yellow pill with copy: "Degraded (auto-fallback) — see Runbook". visible gets red pill and a link to docs + suggest fallback models.
jamal: decision point: when do we promote hidden -> soft_badge? threshold idea: 0.1% of user requests hitting a code over 24h and error regression alert triggered. open to suggestions.
tara: prefer a CI gating rule: can only promote if runbook exists and telemetry shows <5% false-positive for last week. otherwise it just stays hidden and flagged for triage.
maddie: sounds reasonable. action items: 1) eng-runtime: add `exposure_phase` and `client_hint` fields in API output (existing optional). 2) eng-platform: console badges + rollout UI controls. 3) eng-sre: create alert that watches `exposure_phase=soft_badge` surprises.
ethan: will add the fields — default to `hidden` if absent. backward compatible. SDKs should surface `client_hint` in error objects.
remy: telemetry: I'll add tags + a dashboard prototype: "Exposure -> impact" showing request rate, cost delta, and regression rate per error code.
ops-bot: heads-up: deploy window for runtime change is next Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC. any blocking concerns?
natalie: can we gate rollout with a console flag to flip percentage of customers who see soft_badge? need canary.
jamal: we should do phased rollout: 1% initial, 10% after 24h if no regression, then 100%. match with SLA tiering — enterprise customers default to visible? probably not. keep consistent.
tara: enterprise customers should have opt-in to `visible` exposure in org settings. one toggle per-org > audit log.
maddie: runbook snippet to include in docs (short): ```
If exposure_phase=soft_badge:
 - Check routing pool health and fallback logs (path: /var/log/runtime/fallback.log)
 - Confirm cache hit-rate for prefix KV >= expected
 - If regressions > 0.5% -> rollback exposure to hidden and create incident.
```
ethan: codewise, I'll include a short header in responses for easy client parsing: `X-RI-Exposure: soft_badge` so older clients can still route behavior without parsing JSON.
remy: remember to tag traces: OpName + `exposure_phase` for flame graphs. useful to debug whether cache vs kernel selection caused degradation.
jamal: consensus check: exposure_phase enum = [hidden, soft_badge, visible, deprecated]. agree?
tara: +1 to deprecated as a final step for removal.
natalie: UX copy drafts — will share a small PR with pill variants. keep copy concise.
maddie: final call: merge proposal, create RFC in docs repo referencing telemetry dashboard, and schedule runtime change in next deploy window with feature flag.
deploy-bot: created ticket RI-EP-4723 and feature-flag `exposure_phase_canary` set to off.
ethan: assigning PR to @tara for console rollout UI.
remy: I'll seed the dashboard with 90 days of historical telemetry and add alert thresholds.
maddie: thanks all. next check-in Thu 10:30 to validate canary after initial 1% rollout. :thumbsup:
